UPDATE hr_event prev JOIN hr_event cur ON cur.hr_event_id = #{hrEventId} SET prev.effective_to = DATE_SUB(cur.target_effective_from, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE prev.employee_id = cur.employee_id AND prev.event_type = cur.event_type AND prev.event_status = 'APPLIED' AND prev.effective_to IS NULL AND prev.hr_event_id != cur.hr_event_id AND prev.effective_from < cur.target_effective_from
UPDATE hr_event SET event_status = 'FAILED', applied_error = LEFT(#{appliedError}, 500) WHERE hr_event_id = #{hrEventId} AND event_status = 'PENDING'
